name: ANSI/IEEE Three-phase bridge rectifier form
summary: IEEE-library form of three-phase bridge rectifier: a three-phase bridge rectifier converts a documented three-phase AC input into a DC output.
description: This reference locates three-phase bridge rectifier in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented semiconductor components family. A three-phase bridge rectifier converts a documented three-phase AC input into a DC output. Its input phase terminals and DC polarity must be identifiable. The public library uses HDI1V5 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Follow the actual current path and terminal polarity in the surrounding circuit. The symbol identifies an electrical function; voltage, current, energy limits and the device package pinout come from the selected component data rather than from the outline.

Check the rectifier's output and any smoothing network as separate circuit elements. Three-phase rectification differs from a single-phase bridge connection. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
